# Preface {.unnumbered}

This project reproduces the seminal methods used in impact evaluation, on the
canonical datasets the literature demonstrates them on, and checks every result
against the published source.

Each method gets a self-contained example: a short theory summary, the data,
concise code, and a **book check** that puts the output next to the numbers
printed in the reference text. Where a method has no R implementation or no
published target, the example says so instead of showing an unverified number.

The repo says the same thing at three altitudes: the spec in
`.docs/panel-spat-PLAN.md`, the *why* in the theory notes, and the running code
in the examples. `theory/README.md` states that contract; it is a repo document,
not a page of this book.

Anchor texts are @baltagi2021, @pesaran2015 and @croissant2019.

## Node status

Every document here is a **node**, and this checklist is the only place their
status is tracked. A box is ticked when the node is written, not when a
placeholder for it is created. Unticked nodes that already have a link exist as
placeholders describing what they should cover.
